met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over southwest Madhya Pradesh and adjoining north Vidarbha persisted over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, the 13th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across southeast Rajasthan and adjoining north Gujarat during next 24 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Jaisalmer, Kota, centre of Low Pressure Area over southwest Madhya Pradesh and adjoining north Vidarbha, Rajnandagaon, Bhawanipatna and thence east-southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from cyclonic circulation associated with Low Pressure Area over southwest Madhya Pradesh and adjoining north Vidarbha to gulf of Mannar across Marathwada, North Interior Karnataka, Rayalaseema & Tamil Nadu extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
A trough runs from Northeast Arabian Sea to Bihar across Gujarat, cyclonic circulation associated with Low Pressure Area over southwest Madhya Pradesh and adjoining north Vidarbha & southeast Uttar Pradesh and extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Konkan adjoining Eastcentral Arabian sea between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level titling southwestwards with height persists.
The trough from southwest Arabian Sea to centre of Low Pressure Area over southwest Madhya Pradesh and adjoining north Vidarbha across Eastcentral Arabian Sea, Konkan & Goa, Madhya Maharashtra at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 73°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
